The only named lemma, `continuous_vec3EuclideanNorm` in UTensor.lean, is private, so the proposed lemma has to be new and put in a shared module. findings.problem: The proofs of `hu` and `hf` are the same measurability argument, applied to `u` and `f`. Each one re-proves continuity of `vec3EuclideanNorm`, composes it with `ENNReal.ofReal`, transfers measurability to the cylinder by `comp_aestronglyMeasurable`, and restricts the measure with `Measure.restrict_mono hcyl le_rfl`. The same block is also pasted into at least six other Caccioppoli files, always with the same `hc : Continuous (fun v : Vec3 => vec3EuclideanNorm v)` proved by `unfold vec3EuclideanNorm; fun_prop`. The only reusable lemma, `continuous_vec3EuclideanNorm` in UTensor.lean, is `private`, so it cannot be used from these files.
findings.proposed_change: Add one public lemma in a shared module that the Caccioppoli files already import, for example the Setting layer next to `continuous_vec3EuclideanNorm`, which should be made non-private. Its statement would be `theorem aestronglyMeasurable_ofReal_vec3EuclideanNorm_restrict {g : ParabolicPoint → Vec3} {s t : Set ParabolicPoint} (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g (volume.restrict t)) (hst : s ⊆ t) : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun w => ENNReal.ofReal (vec3EuclideanNorm (g w))) (volume.restrict s)`. The proof is: `have hc : Continuous (fun v : Vec3 => vec3EuclideanNorm v) := by unfold vec3EuclideanNorm; fun_prop`, then `exact ((ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.comp hc).comp_aestronglyMeasurable hg).mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono hst le_rfl)`. Both uses here then become `have hu := aestronglyMeasurable_ofReal_vec3EuclideanNorm_restrict hu0 hcyl` and `have hf := aestronglyMeasurable_ofReal_vec3EuclideanNorm_restrict hf0 hcyl`. The types match: `hu0` and `hf0` are measurable for `volume.restrict (spaceTimeSet Ω' J)`, and `hcyl : parabolicCylinder x₀ t₀ ρ ⊆ spaceTimeSet Ω' J` comes from `exists_localBox_of_closure_subset`. The `AEMeasurable` variants in RawI2Bound, RawI3Bound and CaccioppoliEnergy could be derived from it with `.aemeasurable`.
findings.benefit: This removes about 14 duplicated lines here and the same boilerplate in the other files. The continuity and measure-restriction argument then lives in one place. The main proof reads as 'norms of `u` and `f` are a.e. measurable on the cylinder', which is the fact it needs, and any later change to `vec3EuclideanNorm` needs one fix instead of many.
